summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and market developments impacting the retail sector, particularly focusing on regulatory actions and IPO news.

bullets.text: SEBI confirmed a ban on Rajesh Exports for knowingly hiding facts from courts.
The Supreme Court criticized Chhattisgarh HC for failing to grasp basic criminal law principles.
Reliance Jio's IPO price range is set between Rs 1,065 and Rs 1,119 per share.
Tanishq reports over 50% of store purchases now include jewellery exchanges, indicating rising demand for natural diamond jewellery.
India's gem and jewellery exports increased by 9.43% year-on-year in September, driven by demand for studded gold and lab-grown diamonds.
